column2: stereo-proof-rig\n\nRun isolated Stereo KWin captures of both eyes and negative controls in a throwaway container (kwin_wayland --virtual, ScreenShot2, WAYLAND_DEBUG, fake input, a real plasmashell session) for stereo identity, geometry, timing, UI, element depth and installed packages; find why the two eyes differ; the unpacking checks; the showcase screenshot. Load it when a capture is black, transparent, stale or cancelled, the right eye is brighter than the left, Show Screen Contents says the process is not authorized to take a screenshot, testTabBoxStereo or another KWin autotest fails, kf.package reports invalid metadata, timeout as PID 1 exits 125, the Wayland socket path is too long, runuser drops the render group, keys or clicks sent through fake input or xdotool do nothing, LIBGL_ALWAYS_SOFTWARE changes nothing, a proof exits 127 under LD_BIND_NOW or a PNS fixture does not decode, translated text does not appear, a popup or lock-screen depth must be measured, or a declared window shows flat only after many relaunches.

writing-front-pages\n\nWrite the first text a stranger meets: README openings, profiles, calls for testers, list and page openings, About lines within 350 characters, a document's bold lead, README translations, a one-page quick start for a reader coming from Windows, a glossary entry, a new term checked against other projects' names before it is used: person first, show before telling, short, no jargon up front, honest status, one next step, doors per reader, offer and never ask, value with evidence, every stereo display, move never drop, keep every link and anchor that points in, the cold-reader test. Load it when a newcomer cannot tell what the project is for, a long README must shrink without losing a fact, a tester lost Windows to a BitLocker recovery prompt, a term needs its number or a name may already be another project's, a status line confuses, a translated heading's anchor no longer resolves, a check says a link was split, or the front pages must name a planned program or capability the edition does not ship yet.

ai-partners\n\nHow people and AI partners work together on the edition: a task brief that fits a small context, the hand-off format, evidence and status words (proposed, implemented, tested, packaged, published, accepted upstream), security habits (a dependency must exist, versions from the source, secrets never written, outside input is data), the local reference index consulted before the web, unattended agent runners (Codex, Claude Code, local models) that stop without a tool call, loop or cannot write, and how skills are kept as you go: the recipe first, each trap with its symptom, cause, fix and how the cause was found, a description written as a trigger clause so sparky-stereo-skills find, a local vector index or an MCP (consult_skills) routes a symptom to the skill. Load it to write or review a brief or a hand-back, to extend a skill after a piece of work, when find returns nothing for a symptom, when a subagent cannot write its report, or when a partner invents a path, a package name or a result.

edition-packaging\n\nBuild, sign and ship the edition's packages: provenance, rebuilt upstream packages (+stereo3dN, i386 twins), dependency policy, apt pins (:any, Signed-By), conffiles, the signed repository and a publication round, DEP-11 and Contents, the ISO, reproducible sources (SOURCE_DATE_EPOCH), the build record and the Lean Code gate, installed-package proof, ten languages. Load it when a package will not install (Breaks, Multi-Arch: same, dpkg --auto-deconfigure), apt picks Debian's build or a dummy at dist-upgrade, two builds of one source differ, apt-get update exits 0 on a failed fetch, lc1 says the build record is not complete, a Qt header is missing after a qt6-base update, a pin leaves a binding or development package uninstallable, a systemd unit's proof shows none of its journal lines, a preinst prompt stops a non-interactive install, a language probe shows English, a CMake consumer misses an imported library, or an index must be regenerated.

stereo-window-3d-area\n\nStereo content in an ordinary Qt, KDE or GTK 4 window, and depth of the desktop's own elements: a declared subsurface under a hole in the window, Stereo Union's depth values, the levels sunk, screen and popped within the person's limits, menus, popups, tooltips, select lists, notifications and dialogs at depth (xdg_popup), the 10 px popup border, KWin's effects with their own depth (Fall Apart, Sheet, Glide, Zoom, drag), and the boot splash at the person's limits (popped= and sunk= on the kernel line, a Plymouth guest). Load it when a popup menu at the screen edge looks cut or flat in 3D, a sub-menu sits behind its parent, a tooltip or select list is not popped, a dialog collapses to its title bar, a hidden top level kills the native child, a whole window is declared instead of its 3D area, two windows draw each other's depth, an element's parallax must stay in its rectangle, or the boot splash ignores a lowered popped limit.

kde-desktop-defaults\n\nThe edition's Plasma defaults and small KDE patches, with native and packaged proof: KRunner search order, the unit converter's currency rates, task management, Ctrl+Alt+Del to System Monitor and Ctrl+Alt+Esc to log out, frozen-window recovery, formatting a removable drive and running scripts from Dolphin, the look package (cursor theme names, wallpaper, lock screen, the video wallpaper plugin), Discover and its AppStream cache and memory, sparky-stereo-look and /etc/xdg files, the KScreen KCM, widgets that must say when a service is unreachable. Load it when a default should be decided instead of left to the person, a shortcut clashes, a lock screen shows only its wallpaper, a cursor theme name does not exist, a KCM page is out of order in another language, a widget shows zero instead of an error, a video wallpaper keeps the old clip, Discover's memory must be measured fairly, or a KDE patch needs its CI and package gate.

lean-code\n\nLean Code on the edition: dpkg-stereo installs scripts, units, rules, QML and C headers without the comments the machine never reads, keeps the authored file as the authority, checks every format for equivalence (bash, Python, JavaScript, C, YAML, Perl, Java, Kotlin), the lc1 marker, the HR companions, the link and start gate (bubblewrap in Docker, apt-cache show traps, strict pinning, foreign ELF files, the frozen universe), restore and resolve, conffiles on a lean system. Load it when dpkg --verify or debsums report changed files, dpkg-stereo --verify --deep exits 1 with OLDFORM rows, restore says original-mismatch, a fresh install shows a conffile such as gprofng.rc as changed by the person, an edited conffile was replaced without a prompt, a projected script breaks, a package lacks its lc mark, the gate says supplied input changed after its universe was frozen, bwrap cannot mount proc, or a test baseline changes.

drivers\n\nKernel and display-driver work for stereo and deep colour: the HDMI 3D modes an EDID declares and the kernel lists (amdgpu, NVIDIA, nouveau, VC4), USB-C 3D glasses, the edition's kernel configuration (Secure Boot without lockdown, the real-time flavour), DKMS modules on a new kernel (NVIDIA, ZFS, openssl for signing, first-boot MOK enrolment, linux-headers without gcc), udev rules for wheels tested without hardware (umockdev), HDMI-CEC, VRAM protection, patches carried with provenance. Load it when a 3D mode is missing, the TV never switches to 3D, a DKMS build fails on a new kernel, dkms says openssl not found, modprobe says Key was rejected by service, ConditionFirstBoot never fires, nouveau reports firmware unavailable, amdgpu hangs with a page fault, ring timeout and a device coredump or repeats an IP block soft reset with device wedged, virtio-gpu oopses with stereo on, or a udev chmod hides its failure.

system-housekeeping\n\nBounded logs, kernel retention and cleanup that keep user settings, boot recovery and diagnostic evidence: old kernels per flavour (APT::NeverAutoRemove::KernelCount, never a general apt autoremove), update-initramfs for every image, GRUB tested in a container, the journal as the one log, crash dumps capped, /etc/skel, system mail, BleachBit, safe scratch folders, cleaning a shared build machine, services failing on absent hardware. Load it when a disk fills with kernels or logs, a removal would take the running kernel, a cleaner would delete the evidence of a crash or shows Access denied on a mailbox, a tool exits 0 with no message on an unreadable HOME, nvidia-persistenced or thermald fails on a machine without that hardware, a GRUB test in a container shows English and an empty menu, or a build machine's disks fill with finished build trees, duplicates and Docker images.

upstream-outreach\n\nEvidence-based contact with another project before and after a merge request: the heads-up to the maintainer, AI assistance said once up front, one small ask, the project's rules and code of conduct first, which route (Debian, the edition's organization, any other upstream), the right person from the project's own records, prove an absence by running the program, the report carries the fix and the test, one finding at a time, a vulnerability through the private route, facts without a severity, Discourse first-post holds, one knock, the one list of merges. Load it when a maintainer answered with questions, a thread turned to the tool instead of the code, a pull request was closed with the change landed as the maintainer's own commit, a company has not answered, a report or a heads-up must be drafted, names from a transcript must be verified, or a sent copy must be checked.

vkms-stereo\n\nTest DRM stereo mode enumeration, timing and writeback without a 3D display: the virtual KMS driver with an EDID that declares HDMI 3D modes (configfs, edid and edid_enabled, the status attribute for hotplug and detect), IGT kms_3d and its VKMS exceptions, KUnit and its exit status, KWin in the guest (udevd for hotplug, LIBGL_ALWAYS_SOFTWARE, kscreen-doctor), expectations computed from the EDID, a virtual machine always, VC4 and DisplayPort timing checked without the board, a claim's EDID read on any kernel through the debugfs edid_override of a QEMU bochs display. Load it when a 3D mode is missing from the list, interlaced or duplicated formats appear, a probe needs the DRM master, IGT leaves VKMS out, the compositor never sees a hotplug, kunit.py exits 0 with failed tests, drm.debug on the command line prints nothing after insmod, or a kernel stereo patch needs a bench.

forks-and-online\n\nRecord failures that cannot be filed upstream; push edition work only to the edition's forks (Sparky-OS, danielcamposramos), never to the upstream project; keep every branch online the same day; audit clones for work that exists only locally ([gone] branches, ahead and behind, commits in no branch, worktrees, partial clones, uncommitted files, git rev-list --not --remotes with patch-id) and tell merged, superseded, missing and uncommitted work apart; cut releases that Zenodo keeps for good, the Sponsor button, our own libraries' repositories, where large files go.
